project_type: Next.js 16 static site with App Router, bilingual (Vietnamese/English) self-hosted open source directory
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm install to restore dependencies. 2. Run pnpm lint (tsc --noEmit) to verify types. 3. Run pnpm build to verify the static build succeeds.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. No Docker needed (Vercel deployment). No test framework beyond TypeScript checking.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md exists yet - creating one is part of this task.
key_patterns: - All project data lives in data/projects.ts as a typed array. - Bilingual content uses Record<Locale, string> pattern. - Pages use Next.js App Router with [locale] dynamic segment. - Categories, projects, and use cases all use slug-based routing. - Components are in components/ directory, plain CSS in app/globals.css. - Static params generated via generateStaticParams() for SSG. - Site uses CSS custom properties for theming. - No external UI library (all custom CSS).
directory_structure: app/ - Next.js App Router pages and API routes. app/[locale]/ - locale-specific pages. components/ - reusable React components. data/ - project data (projects.ts). lib/ - utility functions (i18n.ts, projects.ts). Root has config files (next.config.ts, tsconfig.json, package.json).
